shouldFix.title: The exact edit leaves a newly measured 2026-08-15 snapshot under a 2026-08-14 heading
shouldFix.finding: Decision 3 requires the snapshot heading date 2026-08-14 to remain unchanged while adding two rows on 2026-08-15 and replacing the condition-2 measurement with 4 of 32. The heading calls the block a dated current-position measurement. After literal application, the block would attribute rows and a count that did not exist on 2026-08-14 to that date. This is the same measurement-integrity class the register already repaired when later owner recordings advanced the snapshot date.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The row insertions and numerical measurement are correct, and the rows remain authoritative if the snapshot is stale. The defect is snapshot metadata, not the operative row standing.
shouldFix.repair: Authorize one additional exact replacement: `### Current position — measured snapshot, 2026-08-14` to `### Current position — measured snapshot, 2026-08-15`. Keep every other snapshot field outside the named count, clause, summary, and heading edits unchanged.

shouldFix.title: Reversibility is misstated as total and does not define the post-dependent overturn path
shouldFix.finding: The subject says only `Total. Overturn: C-D135, plus restore of the two inserted rows and of the two snapshot sentences.` Overturning the insertion requires removing the two rows, not restoring them. More importantly, D-132 sequences reviewed DR-133 and DR-131 contracts after this act, and later SATISFIED re-records may mutate these cells. Once any dependent act lands, reverting D-135 alone cannot be total: it would remove the target rows while leaving independently live decisions or file-08 notes that depend on them. The adopted corpus's reversibility discipline distinguishes total reversal before dependents from owning-entry supersession and MF-6 reconciliation afterward.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: Before any dependent act lands, reverting C-D135 does restore the pre-edit register and snapshot. The defect is an incomplete and partly misworded temporal overturn procedure, not an irreversible row addition.
shouldFix.repair: State that reversal is total only before a dependent DR-131/DR-133 contract, status re-record, or other act lands; at that stage overturn removes the two inserted rows and restores the snapshot heading/count/clause/summary. After a dependent act lands, require its owning-entry supersession or revert and reconciliation of every dependent MF-6 note under its own reviewed act. Preserve D-132, D-133, and D-134 unless separately overturned.
